title: Navigating LLM Ethics: Advancements, Challenges, and Future Directions

bias_targets.target: Social bias (Gender, Race, Age, Religion, Occupation, Socioeconomic)
bias_targets.methodology: As a systematic review, the paper summarizes existing methodologies for measuring social bias, including template-based bias probing (e.g., StereoSet, CrowS-Pairs), likelihood and score-based fairness metrics (e.g., toxicity scores), embedding space analysis (e.g., WEAT, SEAT), and behavioral audits.

The paper reviews the use of tools and benchmarks like XNLI and FLORES to evaluate unequal performance, preferential treatment, and disparities across different languages, dialects, and linguistic styles.

The paper surveys methods that assess the underrepresentation, misrepresentation, or skewed visibility of various demographic, cultural, and socioeconomic groups in both LLM training datasets and generated outputs.
